name: Classes (d20pfsrd)
body:
Archer
How Many	When	Under Condition
1	On making an attack roll	The attack succeeds against a worthy enemy
1	At beginning of turn	You moved only 5 ft. last turn
2	At beginning of turn	You did not move last turn
Armiger
How Many	When	Under Condition
1	At end of turn	You voluntarily gain the Flatfooted condition until your next turn
1	On being attacked	The attack roll does not beat your AC
2	On being attacked	The attack roll does not beat your Flatfooted AC
Barbarian
How Many	When	Under Condition
1	On being hit	The hit deals critical damage
1	At beginning of turn	Your hit points are at 75% of maximum or lower
2	At beginning of turn	Your hit points are at 25% of maximum or lower
Sorcerer
How Many	When	Under Condition
1	On using Spellcraft	You successfully identify a spell as it is being cast
X	On casting a spell	You successfully cast a level X spell
Tactician
How Many	When	Under Condition
1	On ???	???
1	On a Knowledge check	You successfully identify a monster
2	On a Knowledge check	You beat the monster identification DC by 10 or more
